config.title: Your Cost Per 1M Tokens By Provider (Last 30 Days)
Your Time To First Token p50 (Last 30 Days)

dataSourceConfig.sql:
SELECT
    e.tag AS endpoint,
    p.percentile,
    CASE p.percentile WHEN 'p50' THEN e."latency_last_30m.p50" ELSE e."latency_last_30m.p90" END AS latency
FROM Endpoints e, (VALUES ('p50'), ('p90')) AS p(percentile)
ORDER BY e."latency_last_30m.p50" NULLS LAST, e.tag, p.percentile

config.description: Higher is better on every axis. Affordability scores price per 1M tokens on a log scale, from 100 at $0.01 or less to 0 at $1,000 or more. Change the ceiling with the Affordability ceiling parameter.
